evidence_boundary: Historical DreamBank analysis of a defined congenital-blind corpus; it provides historical dream-expression context only and does not establish contemporary AI effects, BLV intent, cognitive equivalence, or a causal dream effect.

Ecological context on visually impaired users interacting with large multimodal models; it does not establish a blind-dream effect, cognitive change, or the effectiveness of the current frozen intervention.
Accessibility-description evaluation context showing limits of reference-only evaluation; it is not dream evidence and does not validate this study's computational measurements as human judgment.

Peer-reviewed workshop article on blind and low-vision image-description preferences; it supplies bounded external BLV-preference context and does not make caption similarity a BLV preference measure for the current outputs.

Accessibility-aware guidance dataset context used only as a separate external human-verified reference; it is not same-item ground truth for the frozen VizWiz outputs and does not evidence dream or cognitive effects.

Methodological caution on testing model simulations against observed human evidence; it does not establish that synthetic annotations are human-equivalent, that models represent blind lived experience, or that this study collected human judgments.
